title: I'm 49, never made a game before, and just spent 1,000 hours building my own fantasy RPG
author: No_Calligrapher_9518
selftext:
I'm 49 years old and live in Sweden. I've never developed a game before, but gaming has been a big part of my life for as long as I can remember.

I grew up playing games like Zelda, and as I got older, games like Diablo and Baldur's Gate really stuck with me. Those are the kinds of games that made me fall in love with gaming, and they're a big part of what inspired me to start making my own game, **The Last One: From Ashby**.

It's a fantasy RPG with turn-based combat, inspired by the games I grew up loving.

Since I had no previous experience in game development, I've been using AI tools to help me along the way. Without them, I probably wouldn't have been able to take on a project like this. It's been a lot of experimenting, learning new things, and figuring stuff out as I go.

So far, I've spent around 1,000 hours working on the game. There have been plenty of mistakes, frustrating moments, and late nights, but I've genuinely had a great time building it.

**The game is completely free to play and runs directly in your browser.** You don't need to download anything or create an account. Just choose to play as a guest and you're good to go.

**You can play the game here:**

[https://thelastone.net](https://thelastone.net)

I never really imagined I'd be making my own game at 49, but here I am. It's pretty amazing what you can create these days with an idea, some patience, and the help of AI tools.

I'd love for people to give it a try, and I'd really appreciate any feedback, good or bad. I'm still learning, and there's always something I can improve.

Most importantly, I hope some of you have as much fun playing it as I've had making it!
